titles.title: UnrealGold
titles.engine_and_build: Unreal Engine 1, Unreal Gold 226b. System\ renderers: D3DDrv.dll (md5 f924e209, logs 'Unreal 1 Direct3D support - internal revision 1.7-UT'), GlideDrv.dll (md5 b0c91ce1) and OpenGlDrv.dll (md5 cbb55304). The tree also ships a game-local nGlide glide2x.dll (1,310,720 B, md5 e4867e04); the launcher moves it aside when FR_GLIDE=1. Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240 (DIRLIST C:\Games, 04:3x).
.243: not deployed, but the reason given is wrong. The published verdict (_gamegate/d931bfe6c33fae5e.txt, 01:04) is an operator override: '3D-noteworthy, but gated until it has a Voodoo launcher for this box'. It is not disk: .243 now installs to GamesDir=E:\GAMES (agent 1.93.1), which has about 71 GB free.
Renderer:
- .123/.145/.195/.240: D3DDrv. Unreal.log reads 'Bound to D3DDrv.dll' with szDriver ati2dvag / nv4_disp / aticfx32 / ati2dvag.
- .124: GlideDrv at launch (GlideRender=1, re-read 04:33, plus VEN_121A). The path is system32 glide2x.dll (94,208 B, md5 a0d0841a = AmigaMerlin's GlideXP Glide2-to-Glide3 translator) into our h5 glide3x.dll (1,025,320 B, md5 38a891e8).
- .124's Unreal.ini currently reads D3DDrv at 1280x960. That is the post-GAMESYNC state; the launcher writes GlideDrv at 1024x768 again at each start.
titles.resolution_per_box:
.123/.145/.195/.240: 1920x1080x32 (ini read-back).
.124: 1024x768 at launch. The launcher's UE1G2W/UE1G2H ladder gives this, and the 09-28 log reads 'grSstOpen Res=0 Ref=12' (labels swapped; 12 = GR_RESOLUTION_1024x768).
Pre-existing writer disagreement on .124 (resolution lane): the gameres.h GR_OP_INI viewport rule writes %W%x%H% = 1280x960 at every sync (read back 1280x960 at 04:00), while the Glide branch of the launcher writes 1024x768 at every launch.
.243: n/a.
titles.refresh_control:
Confirmed.
D3DDrv:
- IDirectDraw7::SetDisplayMode(this,w,h,bpp,refresh=0,flags=0): push 0 / push 0 at 0x1000b2a4/0x1000b2a6, call [edx+0x54] at 0x1000b2c1 (re-disassembled).
- No 'refresh' string, ASCII or UTF-16, case-insensitive, in D3DDrv or OpenGlDrv.
OpenGlDrv: CDS with dmFields 0x180000 (0x1000568d) and flags 4.
GlideDrv:
- [GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice] RefreshRate enum. The UTF-16 names are stored 120Hz 85Hz 100Hz 90Hz 80Hz 75Hz 72Hz 70Hz 60Hz, which is GR_REFRESH order reversed.
- It logs 'Glide: Refresh %i failed, falling back...'.
Our h5 Glide:
- The override is FX_GLIDE_REFRESH, read from the environment first, then HKCU, then HKLM at the getRegPath() key (minihwc.c:4675; hwcGetenv at 9547).
- On XP that key is Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide whenever Services\3dfxvs\Device0 exists, and it exists on .124.
- With no override, Glide passes the app's rate to IDirectDraw2_SetDisplayMode and retries at 0 if that fails (win_mode.c).
titles.set_today:
Staged RefreshRate=60Hz reads back unchanged on all five boxes, and no launcher sets FX_GLIDE_REFRESH.
REFUTED: the .124 override is gone. HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide held FX_GLIDE_REFRESH="75" at 00:34, 04:05 and 04:06 (other lanes' reads). It was ABSENT at 04:33 and again at 04:54 (my REGREADs).
That is after .124's ~04:15 reboot (DriverUpdateBoot 04:15). The V5 lane committed '3dfxctl 2.1.0 ... verified across a real reboot on .124' at 04:17, and 3dfxctl's 'defaults' preset deletes FX_GLIDE_REFRESH.
The copy under Control\Video\{919B6B70-...}\0000\Glide (still "75") is never read by our Glide. No FX_GLIDE_* exists in the system or user environment.
titles.best_per_box:
.123/.145/.240: 1920x1080@60. .240's EDID was back at 04:28 (DELL E2313H, digital).
.195: 1920x1080@60.
.124: 1024x768@85 (GAMERES 04:28). vcr-kmd has timings at 60/70/75/85/100, but the enumerated list tops out at 85.
.243: n/a.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
LCD boxes: 60. Measured on 2026-08-31 by the perbox sweep (DISPLAYCFG while running) on .123, .240 and .246 (today's .195), all 1920x1080@60. Inferred today.
.124: NOW 60, inferred and unmeasured. GlideDrv asks for GR_REFRESH_60Hz ('Res=0'), and with FX_GLIDE_REFRESH absent since about 04:15, glide3x hands 60 straight to SetDisplayMode.
The survey's 75 held only while the override existed. The 03:55-03:59 measurements of that pattern were Quake II, ioquake3, GLQuake and Half-Life, not Unreal.
titles.gap: .124: 60 instead of 85, worse than the survey's 75. LCD boxes: none.
titles.fix:
In the FR_UE1DEV=GlideDrv branch of 'Play Unreal Gold.bat', write [GlideDrv.GlideRenderDevice] RefreshRate=<rate>Hz with FLEETRES -ini at every launch.
- The rate is the best listed rate at the ladder mode (UE1G2W x UE1G2H; 1024x768 gives 85 on .124), snapped down to the enum.
- If the rate is 0 or unknown, leave the staged 60Hz.
- With the override gone, this alone gives 85.
FLEETRES needs a per-resolution query for this, such as '-besthz W H' over the phase-1 gr_target_hz(). FR_HZW and FR_HZ43 are both computed for 1280x960 on .124, not for the ladder mode.
Do not add a gameres.h mirror unless gameres.h also learns GlideRender and the ladder; it already writes a different viewport on .124. A launcher-only key cannot fight: GAMERES never writes it, and GAMESYNC's re-copy only restores 60Hz until the next launch.
The FX_GLIDE_REFRESH env var is optional at best. Set in the launcher, it beats the 3dfx Control Panel's 'Fullscreen refresh rate' (a registry value read after the environment), so it would silently override an explicit operator choice.
titles.fix_risk:
Low on the hardware:
- 85 is listed at 1024x768.
- A rate Glide cannot set falls back to refresh 0 (win_mode.c), which on vcr-kmd lands at 85 per the DirectDraw class.
- GlideDrv also has its own fallback.
Coordination:
- .124 belongs to the V5 lane, so pace CRT mode switches.
- The survey's reason for the 'if not defined' guard is wrong. scripts/benchmarks/v56k_bench.py launches its own V56KBENCH.BAT with SSTH3_SLI_AA_CONFIGURATION and FX_GLIDE_SWAPINTERVAL, pins no FX_GLIDE_REFRESH, and never runs the Play .bat. glidelab only _putenv()s its own --refresh inside its own process.
- The panel value can come back whenever someone picks a rate in 3dfxctl.
titles.verify_on_hw:
.124, only with the V5 lane's agreement:
1. REGREAD HKLM SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\3dfxvs\Device0\glide and note whether FX_GLIDE_REFRESH is present.
2. Launch 'Play Unreal Gold.bat'.
3. Unreal.log should read 'grSstOpen Res=7' (7 = GR_REFRESH_85Hz; the labels are swapped). Today it would read Res=0.
4. DISPLAYCFG get while running should read 1024x768 @85.
5. The vcr-kmd log (EXEC vcrctl log > file, then DOWNLOAD) should show 'mode N: 1024x768x16@85'.
LCD boxes: DISPLAYCFG get should read 1920x1080 @60.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed:
- the static claims (SetDisplayMode re-disassembled, OpenGlDrv 0x180000, GlideDrv strings and enum order)
- the Res/Ref label swap
- the GlideXP translator
- the UE1G2 ladder
- LCD 1080p@60
Refuted:
- the .124 FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=75 set_today, so the expected rate is 60, not 75
- the .243 reason (operator override, not disk)
- 'the harness pins FX_GLIDE_REFRESH=60'
Evidence: .claude/evidence-refresh/secondary-shooters-v2-adversarial/static/124-fx-glide-refresh-timeline.txt, gate-and-deploy-corrections.txt and compat-render-perbox-2026-08-31.txt.

titles.title: UnrealTournament
titles.engine_and_build: Unreal Engine 1, UT99 OldUnreal 469e (SSE2, PE subsystem 5.1). GameRenderDevice=D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice (D3D9Drv.dll md5 01bb5c61; OpenGlDrv md5 09de091f). Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .145 .195 .240, with D3D9Drv in the ini on all four.
.124: absent. The gate says 'no cpu_features: CPU lacks sse2'.
.243: absent, operator override 'not wanted on .243'. The 469e PEs are also XP-only.
titles.refresh_control:
Confirmed by re-disassembly.
D3D9Drv:
- UTF-16 'RefreshRate' at 0x36294.
- At 0x100021a9 and 0x10002354: mov eax,[edi+0x18f94]; test; jle; mov [edi+0x19498],eax. The pp starts at edi+0x19468, so +0x30 is FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz. This applies only when pp.Windowed ([edi+0x19488]) is 0.
- 'Failed to create D3D device with default refresh rate: %ls' at 0x37288.
OpenGLDrv:
- ChangeDisplaySettingsW with dmFields 0x180020, raised to 0x580020 when RefreshRate ([esi+0x5a8]) is non-zero (0x10001d84).
- On failure it retries without DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY (0x10001dd4, and 0xffbfffff).
titles.set_today: Staged RefreshRate=0 in [D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice], read back as 0 on all four (D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT). The launcher and GAMERES write only the viewport and StartupFullscreen. Confirmed.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
60 on all four.
This is not merely inferred: the 2026-08-31 perbox sweep measured .123 and .240 at 1920x1080@60 while running, and .246 (today's .195) was verified at 1920x1080 on D3D9Drv. Today's value is inferred.
titles.gap: None. It is right only because 1080p is 60-only on these panels.
titles.fix: Optional, for determinism: RefreshRate=%HZW% in [D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice] through a GR_OP_INI rule, plus the same FR_HZW value in the launcher's -ini block. Both come from the same phase-1 gr_target_hz(), so the two writers agree. That token is uncommitted and not on hardware. 0 means the default. This changes nothing on today's boxes.
titles.fix_risk: Low. D3D9Drv retries at the default rate if device creation fails, and OpenGLDrv drops DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY and retries.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get while in game should read 1920x1080 @60. Also check System\UnrealTournament.log for the D3D9 device line.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed. Correction: 'not measured' is too strong, because the perbox rows of 2026-08-31 measured 1080p@60.

titles.title: UT2004
titles.engine_and_build:
Unreal Engine 2, UT2004 ECE build 3369. RenderDevice=D3DDrv.D3DRenderDevice (Direct3D 8; D3DDrv.dll md5 b6bb4d87).
Correction: the staged System\ has no D3D9Drv.dll, only D3DDrv, OpenGLDrv and PixoDrv. The ini's [D3D9Drv.D3D9RenderDevice] section is therefore inert. OpenGLDrv also carries DesiredRefreshRate.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240; D3DDrv on all five. The .124 gate verdict is 'marginal'.
.124: UT2004.log (09-28 07:13:56) reads 'Enter SetRes: 1280x960', a 16-bit back buffer, then 'Critical: CreateTexture failed(D3DERR_INVALIDCALL)'.
.243: operator override, 'not wanted'.
titles.refresh_control:
Confirmed. D3DDrv has UTF-16 DesiredRefreshRate (0x5edec) and OverrideDesktopRefreshRate (0x5ef28).
At 0x10011909:
- eax = [esi+0x4190] (DesiredRefreshRate). If eax > 0x3c (60), or [esi+0x416c] (Override) is non-zero, then wanted = eax; otherwise wanted = 0.
Mode loop 0x10011935-0x100119a6:
- It picks the minimum of |dw|+|dh|+|dbpp|; on a tie it prefers refresh == wanted.
At 0x10011a15-0x10011a2d:
- The pp refresh ([esi+0x46ec]) is the matched mode's rate if wanted is set, else 0.
The log line 'Best-match display mode: %ix%ix%i@%i' is at 0x10061f70.
titles.set_today:
Staged and read back: DesiredRefreshRate=60 and OverrideDesktopRefreshRate=False in [D3DDrv.D3DRenderDevice], so wanted = 0 and the device uses D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT.
gameres.h defines %HZOVERRIDE% but no rule uses it. Confirmed.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
LCD boxes: 60. Measured on 2026-08-31 by perbox on .123, .240 and .246 (1920x1080@60). The UT2004.log files on the LCD boxes were 0 bytes at 04:00, so nothing is newer. Inferred today.
.124: 85, measured 2026-09-28. The vcr-kmd event at 680.2 s is mode 90, 1280x960x16@85. That matches the 07:13:59 UT2004 slot in d3d32_step16/step16_run.log and the log's 1280x960 with a 16-bit buffer. The game then aborts.
titles.gap: None. On .124 the blocker is the renderer, not the refresh.
titles.fix:
For determinism only:
- Add GR_OP_INI rules DesiredRefreshRate=%HZW% and OverrideDesktopRefreshRate=%HZOVERRIDE% under [D3DDrv.D3DRenderDevice] only. Drop the D3D9Drv half; there is no D3D9Drv.dll.
- Add matching FLEETRES -ini lines from FR_HZW to both launchers. The phase-1 tokens are uncommitted.
- Today's value is 60 on the LCD boxes, so nothing changes.
titles.fix_risk: Low. The match loop accepts only enumerated modes, and the wanted rate at 1080p is 60.
titles.verify_on_hw: UT2004.log 'Best-match display mode: WxHxB@Hz', which prints the enumerated mode's rate. Also DISPLAYCFG get while in game.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed by re-disassembly. Corrections:
- the D3D9Drv section is inert
- 'LCD 60, inferred' can cite the 2026-08-31 perbox measurements

titles.refresh_control:
None. Confirmed.
- main.exe calls IDirectDraw4::SetDisplayMode(this,w,h,bpp,ebx,ebx) at 0x5354f0, and the 640x480x16 path at 0x535530.
- A case-insensitive scan of main.exe and 'Descent 3.exe', ASCII and UTF-16, finds no refresh switch.

titles.best_per_box:
1080p: 60 on .123/.145/.195/.240.
640x480 (menus): 75 on .123/.145/.240 and 60 on .195. Caveat: GAMERES merges 16 and 32 bpp, so 75 is not proven for the 16-bit menu mode itself.
.124: 85.
.243: n/a.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
Menus:
- .123: measured 640x480x16 @60 today (00:54, 1080p lane) and 640x480@60 on 2026-08-31 (perbox).
- .246 (.195): 640x480@60.
In flight:
- .240: measured 1920x1080@60 (perbox, 2026-08-31).
- Other LCD boxes: 60 at 1080p.
.124: 85, inferred from the vcr-kmd DirectDraw class.
On .123 the attribution 'kept the desktop's 60' cannot be told apart from 'XP's default 60', because the desktop is itself 60.
titles.gap: Menus only: 60 instead of the listed 75 on .123/.145/.240. On an LCD the visible benefit of 75 Hz at a scaled mode is unproven.
titles.fix: There is no title knob. Only a game-local ddraw request-fixing shim can help (mechanism lane option e). The other DirectDraw-capable route, monitor MODES range pinning (option d2), is machine-wide and not recommended. DirectDraw\ForceRefreshRate must not be used: it forces one rate for every size and would break the 60-only 1080p in-flight switch. Accepting 60 in the menus is reasonable.
titles.fix_risk: The shim is medium risk: a new, untested binary beside main.exe.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get at the main menu (640x480x16 @N) and again in flight (1920x1080x16 @N).
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed. Caveats added on the depth-merged best rate and on the mechanism attribution.

titles.title: SeriousSamFirstEncounter
titles.engine_and_build: Croteam Serious Engine 1, TFE retail v1.00 (Engine.dll build 10000.1, md5 6281c69e). OpenGL only: Engine.dll names OPENGL32.DLL and 3DFXVGL.DLL, and no D3D8.DLL. SeriousSam.exe declares 'persistent INDEX sam_iDriver;'. Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240.
Run history:
- SeriousSam.log exists only on .195 and .240.
- .124 and .145 have neither a log nor Scripts\PersistentSymbols.ini, and .123 has no log. TFE has never run on the current .124 stack.
- .240's log predates two card swaps. HWPROFILE now shows a Radeon X1600 attached; the X800 and 9800 XT keys are not attached.
.195: PersistentSymbols.ini pins sam_iDriver=1, the 3Dfx MiniGL path ('Starting display mode: 1920x1080xDesktop 3Dfx fullscreen'). Every mode returns DISP_CHANGE_BADMODE, the ICD fallbacks included.
.243: operator override, 'not wanted'.
titles.resolution_per_box:
1920x1080 on .123/.145/.240. The .240 log reads 'CDS: mode set to 1920x1080x0'.
.195: no mode is set.
.124: 1280x960.
titles.refresh_control:
gfx_iRefreshRate ('persistent user INDEX gfx_iRefreshRate;'). Confirmed by re-disassembly of the CDS at 0x600faedd:
- dmFields is 0x380000 (DM_DISPLAYFLAGS | PELSWIDTH | PELSHEIGHT), with dmDisplayFlags = 4, i.e. DMDISPLAYFLAGS_TEXTMODE (CDS_FULLSCREEN misused).
- It becomes 0x780000, with dmDisplayFrequency set, when gfx_iRefreshRate > 0 (0x600faf05-0x600faf1c).
titles.set_today:
All three launchers echo 'gfx_iRefreshRate=%FR_HZ%;' into Scripts\Game_startup.ini at every start, and GAMERES's 'ssam' body writes %FRHZ%.
Read back: 60 on the LCD boxes and 85 on .124. TFE accepts the line. Confirmed.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
XP LCD boxes: 60. The .240 log shows it, on older hardware; .123 and .145 are unmeasured.
.195: the game does not start.
.124: NOW 85, inferred, and never run. The CDS asks for 1280x960@85, and MesaFX/Glide asks for 85 with no FX_GLIDE_REFRESH override left (the survey's 75 depended on it).
titles.gap:
.195: the game does not start; the refresh line is the prime suspect.
.124: no refresh loss while the override stays absent.
titles.fix:
(1) The .124 FX_GLIDE_REFRESH step is no longer needed.
(2) .195: A/B ONE variable per run. First set gfx_iRefreshRate=0 and leave sam_iDriver=1; then change sam_iDriver separately. The survey's combined A/B cannot attribute the result.
- Hypothesis to test: Win7 WDDM rejects the TEXTMODE display flag (set by both TFE and TSE) only when DM_DISPLAYFREQUENCY is also present. TSE, with no rate, sets 1920x1080 on .195; TFE, with 60, gets BADMODE for every mode.
- If that holds, the rule is 'no Serious Engine refresh line on Win7', not 'emit 0 when only one rate is listed'.
(3) Later, both writers move to the per-target token.
titles.fix_risk:
Low, but the .195 cause stays a hypothesis until the A/B runs.
There is a latent writer fight in the shared Game_startup.ini:
- FLEETRES's FR_HZ falls back to the LIVE rate when the persisted rate is out of range (fleetres.c:882-884).
- gameres.h's %FRHZ% falls back straight to 60 (gameres.h:467).
- So the two disagree on any box whose persisted rate reads 0/1. No box does today; the persisted rates are 60, 85 and 75.
- The phase-1 shared gr_target_hz() closes this only if the ssam line moves to it.
titles.verify_on_hw: SeriousSam.log: 'CDS: mode set to WxHx0' versus 'CDS error: DISP_CHANGE_BADMODE'. DISPLAYCFG get while running. On .124, the final Glide mode line in the vcr-kmd log.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed:
- the statics
- the sam_iDriver correction
Refuted or updated:
- the .124 expected rate (85)
- the 'ICD is retroicd' claim is true, but TFE has never run there
- the A/B design must change one variable at a time
- the latent FR_HZ fallback mismatch is new

titles.title: SeriousSamSecondEncounter
titles.engine_and_build: Serious Engine 1, TSE retail v1.05 (Engine.dll build 10000.5, md5 230c1b52). OpenGL and Direct3D 8 (Engine.dll names D3D8.DLL), selected by sam_iGfxAPI. Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240.
SeriousSam.log exists on .195 (HD 5450, OpenGL) and on .240 (the log reads RADEON 9800 XT; the box now has an X1600). .124 and .145 have no log and no PersistentSymbols.ini. The 1080p lane ran it on .123 (OpenGL).
.124: MesaFX over Glide by default; never run.
.243: operator override, 'not wanted'.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080 on the LCD boxes ('CDS: mode set to 1920x1080x0' on .195 and .240). 1280x960 on .124.
titles.refresh_control:
gap_iRefreshRate, not gfx_iRefreshRate; Engine.dll declares only 'persistent user INDEX gap_iRefreshRate;'. Confirmed.
The CDS at 0x6003ad1d is byte-for-byte TFE's: dmDisplayFlags=4 (TEXTMODE) under DM_DISPLAYFLAGS, and 0x780000 with dmDisplayFrequency when the rate is > 0. The D3D8 pp is at 0x6004c27a (prior claim).
titles.set_today:
Broken. The launchers and GAMERES write 'gfx_iRefreshRate=<FRHZ>;', which TSE rejects: 'not declared' in the .195 and .240 logs, and in the 1080p lane's .123 log.
Confirmed: the launcher's first echo into Game_startup.ini uses '>' (truncate), so the four shipped sam_str* lines are destroyed at every start.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
LCD boxes: 60, the only rate.
.124: NOW 85 on either API, inferred and never run on vcr-kmd.
- OpenGL: the CDS with no rate lands at 60 (GDI class), then MesaFX re-sets the mode through Glide at 85, with no override left.
- D3D8: 85 (DirectDraw/D3D class).
titles.gap: The refresh line is dead on every box. That costs nothing at 60-only 1080p, and on .124 nothing while the override stays absent.
titles.fix:
Give TSE its own body, as the survey proposes:
- gap_iRefreshRate=<per-target rate>
- ssam_startup_ini() takes the variable name
- regenerate the three TSE launchers from the specs
- split test_gameres.c:579 per title
Restore the four sam_str* lines, ideally through Scripts\FleetRes.ini included by the staged Game_startup.ini.
Do not emit any gap_iRefreshRate on Win7 until the TFE A/B clears the TEXTMODE-plus-frequency hazard; the CDS routine is identical. Emit 0 where the target lists only one rate.
titles.fix_risk: Medium. A refused CDS drops through the recovery modes to FatalError, as TFE does on .195. The same latent FR_HZ/%FRHZ% fallback mismatch applies to this shared file (see TFE).
titles.verify_on_hw: SeriousSam.log must not contain "'gap_iRefreshRate' is not declared". In the SE console, type gap_iRefreshRate. Then DISPLAYCFG get while running.
titles.verifier_notes:
Confirmed:
- the statics
- the dead line
- the '>' truncation
Updated:
- the .124 expected rate (85, not '75 or 85')
- the Win7 caution now has a concrete mechanism

titles.title: Halo
titles.engine_and_build: Halo: Combat Evolved PC 1.10, the Gearbox Direct3D 9 port (halo.exe md5 b7aa8f68, 2,822,144 B). Strings.dll documents -vidmode as 'Forces the game to run at width, height[, refresh]'. Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Runnable on .123 .145 .195 .240.
.124 is REFUTED ('gate refuses, cannot run'); it is RUNNABLE:
- The published verdict for .124 (dec95d42ad08a34d) is 'run' by operator override: 'V5 6000 on vcr-kmd with Diag D3D32 + D3DBigTex armed and config.txt DisableRenderTargets - menu verified 2026-09-28'.
- The tree is the library one (DIRLIST: 41 entries, Play Halo.bat 680 B). vcrmp\Diag has D3D32=1 and D3DBigTex=7.
- The V5 plan (09-29 00:00) records 'PASS to the textured main menu from the LIBRARY tree ... fullscreen 1280x960'.
- Gameplay on this non-SSE2 CPU is unverified.
Launchers: .123 and .124 carry the current 680 B launcher (md5 e3f9bcbb, equal to the library's). .145, .195 and .240 still carry the 104 B one (md5 ab92a422).
.243: operator override, 'not wanted'.
titles.refresh_control:
-vidmode w,h,r, parsed at 0x5168c0 with sscanf '%d,%d,%d'. The '-refresh N' switch at 0x66ed70 writes the same variable, and there is also the console variable rasterizer_refresh_rate. Confirmed.
Note: a 2-field -vidmode leaves the refresh out-pointer untouched, so the refresh stays whatever the caller already had; it does not become 60.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
LCD boxes: 60. Measured on 2026-08-31 by perbox: .123 'runs' at 1920x1080@60; .240 and .246 verified.
.124: 85, inferred and unmeasured. The value is passed through the D3D9 present parameters, and vcr-kmd lists 1280x960x32@85 (mode 160).
titles.gap: None today. Latent: FR_HZ is the desktop's rate. On a box whose desktop rate is above the target's maximum, D3D9 CreateDevice would fail.
titles.fix:
Pass the per-target FR_HZW (the phase-1 token) instead of FR_HZ. When it is 0, prefer '-vidmode W,H' only if Halo's own saved rate is known to be sane, because the 2-field form keeps the caller's value.
Unrelated to refresh: GAMESYNC RESET+START on .145, .195 and .240 so they get the current launcher.
Leave .124 alone; it is armed for the LAN party.
titles.fix_risk: Low. FR_HZW is listed at W x H by construction.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get while in game. On .124, only with the V5 lane: the vcr-kmd log 'DrvEnablePDEV mode 160 ... 00000055'.
titles.verifier_notes: Refuted: .124 is runnable (operator override, and the menu was verified). Confirmed: the parser and the LCD values. Evidence: static/gate-and-deploy-corrections.txt.

titles.refresh_control:
None. Confirmed.
- A case-insensitive scan of Bin32 finds no refresh cvar; the only near miss is r_DisplayInfo.
- XRenderD3D9 does mov [esi+0x1b6a0],edi (edi = 0) at 0x38011592, and copies that into pp+0x30 ([esi+0x1b6f0]) at 0x380532dd/0x380532e9.
- PresentationInterval ([esi+0x1b6f4]) is 0x80000000 (IMMEDIATE); that is vsync, not refresh.

titles.title: BF1942
titles.engine_and_build: Refractor 1, Battlefield 1942 v1.61b (BF1942.exe md5 a56d63e8, Direct3D 8). SafeDisc 2.80.010 sits in Mods\bf1942\Mod.dll. Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The .124 gate verdict is 'marginal'.
The client never runs here: SafeDisc 2.80 is not satisfied, and the compat DB has runs=failed on .124, .240 and .246, and n/a on .123. The Host launcher's dedicated server has no display.
.243: operator override, 'not wanted'.
titles.resolution_per_box: 1920x1080x32 on the LCD boxes and 1280x960x32 on .124, in both Profiles\Default\Video.con and Profiles\Custom\Video.con. Moot while the client cannot start.
titles.refresh_control:
The fourth argument of 'game.setGameDisplayMode W H BPP HZ'. The setter at 0x6af100 zeroes HZ unless renderer.allowAllRefreshRates is set (0x4440f0: NT takes the argument, 98/ME forced to 0). Confirmed.
REFUTED: 'which nothing executes'. BF1942.exe executes Settings/VideoDefault.con at EVERY start, and that file contains renderer.allowAllRefreshRates 1 and renderer.setFullScreen 1.
- It runs at 0x46315b, inside 0x462f50.
- 0x462f50 is called on the setup path at 0x456762, after the 'Renderer:' log line.
- Setup (0x455db0) runs BEFORE the settings loader (0x4544c0 to 0x452400 to 0x44f350, which runs Settings/Video.con and then Profiles/Default/Video.con) at both call sites: 0x457202 then 0x45721f, and 0x45834e then 0x4583f6.
- The console runner is vtable+0x20 of [0x9a9420], i.e. 0x5a1590, the .con file executor.
- The options-menu builder 0x6b0520 also runs Video.con and then VideoDefault.con, and lists '%dx%dx%d @ %d' when the flag is set.
So on NT the flag is already 1 when the profile's setGameDisplayMode runs, and a non-zero fourth argument is honoured. README-FLEET.txt already relies on VideoDefault.con for fullscreen.
Still untraced: the path from the stored rate (+0x4c) to m_d3dpp.FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz.
titles.set_today: The fourth argument is 0 in both profiles (launcher -setline and the gameres.h rule), so there is no rate (D3DPRESENT_RATE_DEFAULT). allowAllRefreshRates is already 1 at startup through VideoDefault.con.
titles.expected_today_per_box: n/a: the client does not start. If it did: 60 on the LCD boxes and 85 on .124 (D3D8 class).
titles.gap: None in effect; the problem is latent.
titles.fix:
Only the survey's step (2): write the fourth argument as FR_HZW / %HZW% (0 when unknown) in BOTH writers. Their SETLINE strings must stay byte-identical.
Step (1) is unnecessary: the flag line as the first line of Video.con, and the new insert-before op. VideoDefault.con already sets the flag before Video.con runs, on NT.
titles.fix_risk: Medium. A rate the adapter does not list at W x H would fail D3D8 CreateDevice, so use only enumerated per-target rates. Latent until SafeDisc 2.80 is solved.
titles.verify_on_hw: Once the client runs: DISPLAYCFG get while in game. The options menu should list modes as 'WxHxB @ Hz', which proves the flag is on.
titles.verifier_notes: Refuted the central claim with a traced call order; evidence in static/bf1942-videodefault-executed-at-startup.disasm.txt. The fix simplifies to one argument.

titles.title: RedFaction
titles.engine_and_build: Geo-Mod, Red Faction build 177 (rf.exe md5 0ba3b15d), Direct3D 8. Confirmed.
titles.resolution_per_box:
640x480x16 on every box today.
The launcher and gameres.h write HKLM, but rf.exe's config helper defaults its root to HKEY_CURRENT_USER: 'mov ebp,0x80000001' at 0x52b2b3, and only a section starting with 'hkey' picks another root.
HKCU holds only UpdateRate, ForcePort, StraightToSetup, Geometry Cache Size, Fast Animations and Vsync on all five boxes. Confirmed.
titles.refresh_control: None. Confirmed. The D3D8 present parameters are zeroed and FullScreen_RefreshRateInHz has no writer (prior claim). The registry names are Resolution Width, Resolution Height, Resolution Bit Depth and Vsync.
titles.best_per_box: At 640x480: 75 on .123/.145/.240 (GAMERES merges 16 and 32 bpp, so 16-bit at 75 is unproven), 60 on .195, 85 on .124. .243: n/a.

titles.title: Turok2
titles.engine_and_build: Acclaim/Iguana Turok 2 (1998). Renderer Video_D3D.dll (md5 b3919d01), DirectDraw v1 plus D3D. Video_3DFx.dll is present but unused. Confirmed.
titles.on_boxes:
Deployed on .123 .124 .145 .195 .240. The multiplayer and LAN-join launchers run Turok2MPEnglish.exe. config.ned holds only VideoD3D keys, including 'Wait^for^VSync 1', which is vsync, not refresh.
.243: operator override, 'not wanted'.
titles.resolution_per_box:
1024x768x32 at launch: the T2SEL ladder maps FR_W43=1280 to 1024.
Between launches, GAMERES's %SEL43% writes all six mode lines to 0, because the 4:3 target is 1280x960, not 1024x768. Read back all 0 on five boxes; the writers fight. Confirmed.
titles.refresh_control: None. Confirmed. At 0x10007b35: push bpp, h, w, this, then call [ecx+0x54], which is IDirectDraw v1 SetDisplayMode with no refresh parameter. Video_3DFx.dll's 'Refresh' option is Glide-only.
titles.expected_today_per_box:
.123/.145/.240: 60, inferred from the DirectDraw class measured on .123.
.195: 60.
.124: 85, inferred.
The 2026-08-31 perbox rows showing Turok 2 at 1920x1080@60 are not the game's mode (Video_D3D's list tops out at 1280x1024); DISPLAYCFG read the desktop, so they should not be cited.
titles.gap: 60 instead of 75 on .123/.145/.240. On an LCD the visible benefit at a scaled 1024x768 is unproven.
titles.fix: No title knob exists. The options are the ddraw request-fixing shim (option e), or DirectDraw\ForceRefreshRate set to the best rate at 1024x768 around 'start /wait'. ForceRefreshRate is machine-wide, affects every DirectDraw app while set, and is unmeasured. refreshkeep must not run on an exclusive-DirectDraw title. Separately, the GAMERES rule should use the launcher's ladder (resolution lane).
titles.fix_risk: ForceRefreshRate is machine-wide and unmeasured on these drivers. The shim is an untested binary.
titles.verify_on_hw: DISPLAYCFG get during a multiplayer game; expect 1024x768x32 @N.
titles.verifier_notes: Confirmed. Warns against citing the perbox 1920x1080 rows for this title.
